answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer entering the orchard gets five random peer auditors drawn from a lagoon of veterans, each staking a marble worth 40 POA. Auditors check the newcomer's work history; a majority verdict of fake slashes the 40 POA and rejects it. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, each facing new auditors. Honest agents pay once, keep their marble, and earn rewards undiluted by fakes.
